siteMeta.title: MinCFO
siteMeta.description: MinCFO combines automation, real-time dashboards and an AI copilot for modern teams.

offering.title: Three ways to work with MinCFO
offering.intro: Start with the setup that fits your company today. Switch modes to see how the offering, customer examples and CTA change.

showcase.previewLabel: Read a short overview of our offerings and click through to the one that fits you best.

platform.title: MinCFO platform
platform.body: For companies with their day-to-day in order that want to get more out of their data. With MinCFO you turn numbers into strategic insights in real time.

full-service.title: Your finance function as-a-service
full-service.body: MinCFO takes full ownership of reporting, follow-up and financial structure. Level up to a finance function that stays several steps ahead!

serviceVisual.title: We are your entire finance function

partner.eyebrow: For accounting firms and finance consultants
partner.title: More proactivity and scalability
partner.body: Streamline advisory and client communication across your entire client portfolio. With one unified model you onboard new companies faster and ensure high-quality delivery in every engagement.

options.label: Full-service
options.title: MinCFO as your outsourced finance function
options.body: For companies that want MinCFO to handle finance, reporting and follow-up for them, while the team tracks the situation in real time in the platform.
bullets: We run the finance flow end-to-end
You get clear follow-up on KPIs, cash flow and deviations
Ideal for teams that want to focus on the business

options.label: Platform
options.title: MinCFO platform
options.body: For companies that already handle finance in-house or via a partner and want AI, dashboards and forecasting in one modern system.
bullets: Ideal for teams with working finance operations ready to level up

options.label: For firms
options.title: MinCFO for multi-client delivery
options.body: For firms and Fractional CFOs that want to standardize follow-up, deliver better advisory and work more scalably across multiple clients.
bullets: Onboard new clients in a ready-made model — skip time-consuming custom setups.
Visualize the client's future with AI-driven dashboards and forecasts.
The obvious platform for firms, advisors and Fractional CFOs.

steps.title: Create account
steps.body: Get started right away in the platform.
highlights: Create an account and integrate your accounting system in minutes
Secure onboarding with verification
Instant access to the platform

steps.title: Connect your accounting system
steps.body: Connect to your existing accounting system in a few clicks. MinCFO automatically sets up dashboards and report structure.
highlights: Connect your accounting system in a few clicks
Customizable dashboards and report structure are set up
Data syncs continuously to MinCFO once the connection is active

steps.title: Real-time insights with MinCFO AI
steps.body: AI that answers questions about your company's numbers, real-time reporting in a custom structure and an automatically updated cash flow forecast.
highlights: Real-time reporting of key metrics
Cash flow optimization in real time
Identify opportunities for optimized financial control

steps.title: Onboarding & scope
steps.body: We set goals, structure and scope: accounting, payroll, VAT, year-end, CFO support and more.
highlights: Shared goals and priorities
Clear scope for responsibility and delivery
A plan for accounting, payroll, VAT and year-end

steps.title: Connect systems & permissions
steps.body: You give us access to your bank, the Swedish Tax Agency and Fortnox/other systems. MinCFO is connected as your shared dashboard.
highlights: Secure access to bank and the Tax Agency
Fortnox and other systems are connected
Permissions and roles are set up correctly

steps.title: We run finance — you follow in real time
steps.body: We manage the entire finance flow end-to-end. You see reports, cash flow, key metrics and deviations in MinCFO.
highlights: Reports and KPIs update continuously in the same dashboard
Cash flow, liquidity and outcome tracked in real time
Deviations are flagged immediately with clear next steps

steps.title: AI + proactive advisory
steps.body: The AI answers questions about your data, flags risks and suggests actions. You also have a personal controller/CFO on demand.

steps.title: Optimize your client management
steps.body: Stop building every client journey from scratch. By setting a shared standard for dashboards and KPIs, every new client is onboarded in a proven way instead of as a time-consuming special case.
highlights: Free up time for proactive advisory by automating the setup of every new client journey.
Increase profitability per engagement with standardized delivery and less need for custom work.
Ensure a consistent client experience regardless of which consultant owns the delivery.

steps.title: Track the client portfolio
steps.body: Get a consolidated view of all clients and immediately spot which companies are off budget, have strained liquidity or are ready for the next advisory meeting.
highlights: Easier follow-up across multiple clients at once
Automatic warning signals for cash flow risks and deviations
Compare key metrics between clients and industry segments

steps.title: Scale your advisory with precision
steps.body: Use MinCFO as your digital analyst. With AI support and automated report packages you shorten the path from bookkeeping to business value, so you can act as a proactive partner rather than a reactive supplier.
highlights: Ready-made analyses and suggested actions directly in the platform
Present polished dashboards directly in the client's workspace
Increase the number of clients while maintaining precision

security.title: Enterprise-grade security
security.intro: We handle sensitive financial data with the highest standards of security, privacy and compliance.

cards.body: MinCFO handles all customer data confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law. Access is strictly limited and continuously logged.
cards.title: Data protection & privacy

cards.body: The systems are built with modern security principles and protected through encryption, monitoring and regular security reviews.
cards.title: Secure infrastructure

cards.body: All processing of personal and company data is carried out in accordance with GDPR. Data is handled within the EU and under clear data processing agreements.
